description: The bar chart illustrates the Execution Accuracy of two different methods across various difficulty levels and a total aggregate. The horizontal axis displays the categories, ordered from left to right as Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total, without a specific overarching axis label. The vertical axis represents the value and is labeled "Execution Accuracy," featuring a linear scale that ranges from 20 to 60 with tick marks and corresponding light gray grid lines at intervals of 10. The chart utilizes grouped vertical bars, where each category on the horizontal axis contains a pair of bars. According to the legend positioned at the top, the light blue bars represent "NatSQL" and the dark blue bars represent "TA-SQL," arranged side-by-side from left to right within each group. Every bar is visually emphasized with an exact numerical annotation at its top. For the "Simple" category, NatSQL is 60.21 and TA-SQL is 63.14. In the "Moderate" category, NatSQL is 39.64 and TA-SQL is 48.60. For the "Challenging" category, NatSQL is 32.32 and TA-SQL is 36.11. Finally, in the "Total" category, NatSQL is 51.35 and TA-SQL is 56.19. The shortest bar in the chart corresponds to NatSQL in the Challenging category with a value of 32.32, while the tallest bar is TA-SQL in the Simple category at 63.14. The categories are ordered by difficulty level followed by the total, rather than being sorted strictly by numerical value.
